title: Trouble in the Woods

{{ Quest infobox | id = 90 | name = Trouble in the Woods | given by = [[Town Crier]] | given at = [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)]] | region = Ascalon (pre-Searing) | campaign = Prophecies | type = Secondary | nationality = Tyrian | followed by = [[Charr in the Catacombs]]
[[The True King]] | preceded by = [[Profession Test| Test]] | map = [[Image:Trouble in the Woods map.jpg‎|250px]] | map1text = The path to [[Devona]] and the [[Grawl]] attackers. | experience reward = 500 | completion reward = 25g ({{reforgedmode}} only), [[War Hammer]] }} Defend the village of [[Ashford]] from encroaching [[Grawl]] invaders. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | test = y | minimum = 2 }} ===Objectives=== * Go to [[Lakeside County]] and follow the road to Ashford. Talk to [[Devona]] about the Grawl threat. * Go with Devona and destroy the Grawl threatening Ashford. ===Reward=== * 500 [[Experience]] * 25 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) * [[War Hammer (Trouble in the Woods)|War Hammer of Fortitude]] ** [[Blunt Dmg]]: 8-10 ** Damage +10% (while in a Stance) ** Health +10 ** Two-handed ==Walkthrough== From [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)|Ascalon City]], follow the southwest road to Ashford. Talk to Devona, then follow her across the bridge to trigger the Grawl ambush. Watch out for [[Grawl Shaman]]s who use [[Infuse Health]] and [[Heal Area]]; it may be worthwile to focus on them first. Since there are quite a few Grawl here, consider taking a healing spell to heal yourself and Devona if needed. Keep your distance and let the Grawl waves come to you. Devona will often pull [[aggro]] from nearby [[skale]], so a cautious approach prevents you from being overwhelmed. During the ambush, the [[Charr]] [[ranger]] [[Vatlaaw Doomtooth]] will spawn, cast [[Favorable Winds]], and immediately flee through the portal to [[Regent Valley (pre-Searing)|Regent Valley]]. Usually, he will escape before you can reach him. Once the Grawl are defeated, speak to Devona to claim your reward. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== * {{w}} 5 [[Devona]] ===Foes=== [[Grawl]] * {{r}} 1 [[Grawl (Pre-Searing)|Grawl]] * {{r}} 3 [[Grawl Longspear]] * {{mo}} 2 [[Grawl Shaman]] ====Bosses==== [[Charr]] * {{r}} 6 [[Vatlaaw Doomtooth]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Town Crier :''"Grim news from Devona in Ashford: A clan of '''Grawl''' has swept north from the woods and into Lakeside County. If they are not stopped, the village will surely be destroyed! Someone must fight these creatures and protect the people of Ashford.'' :''"Coordinate your efforts with '''Devona'''."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I'll stop the Grawl! | decline = Ashford is not my concern. | ask = You must hurry. You can follow the road to Ashford. '''Devona''' can surely guide you from there. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== ;Devona :''"The Grawl have been mustering south of the bridge. Let's see if we can turn back their attack. Follow me!"'' Upon encountering Vatlaaw Doomtooth: :'''Devona''': ''"What is that Charr doing south of the wall?"'' ===Reward Dialogue=== ;Devona :''"Aye. I think the village is safe for now. The Grawl are not very intelligent, but even they understand a show of force. What really troubles me is the presence of that Charr Ranger. Could he be inciting the Grawl to attack for some reason? I will warn Rurik of this threat. Thank you for your aid."'' ==Notes== * With some preparation it is actually possible kill Vatlaaw. To do so you will usually want high firepower, [[Imagined Burden]] to slow him down, and/or the use of [[minion]]s or [[gwen]] to [[bodyblock]] him. When blocked, he will not fight back and can be easily killed. You will have to follow a method to stand in his path before he spawns: ** Sneak around the devourer cave (after talking to Devona) to the east. This way, he will be forced to run into you while trying to flee into Regent Valley. ** Bring another player of significant level that will be waiting at Vatlaaw's spawn point up the road from [[Ashford]]. ** Using a [[cupcake]] may also work. {{bug| Vatlaaw will occasionally become blocked or stuck, and not make his escape.}} {{bug| Vatlaaw automatically casts Favorable Winds on spawn, however does two knockdown animations during the cast even though he is not being knocked down.}} {{Pre-Searing Quest nav}}
